final_message:
`int_to_roman(4)` now returns `'IV'`. I changed the lookup table in `src/roman.py` to include the subtractive pairs (900, 400, 90, 40, 9, 4). The old table only had the plain symbols, so 4 came out as `IIII`.

`int_to_roman(1994)` now gives `MCMXCIV`, and converting every number from 1 to 3999 to Roman and back with `roman_to_int` returns the original number. The repo has no test suite, so I only ran those two checks.
